ru_RU.title: LinkedIn
ru_RU.description:
Приложение LinkedIn позволяет легче устанавливать контакты с людьми и делать то, что актуально в вашем профессиональном мире. Создайте и развивайте свою сеть профессиональных контактов, оставайтесь в курсе последних новостей бизнеса и отрасли и найдите работу своей мечты.

Всё это начинается с вашего профиля в LinkedIn. Ваш профиль — нечто большее, чем обычное профессиональное резюме. Он демонстрирует миру, кем вы являетесь и чего достигли в своей карьере. Но это всего лишь начало. С помощью приложения LinkedIn вы можете:
• Выполнять поиск людей, вакансий, компаний и групп
• Получать обновления от людей, издателей и компаний, которые могут способствовать вашему профессиональному успеху
• Рассказать о себе с помощью профессионального профиля и создать собственный профессиональный имидж
• Обновить и улучшить свой профиль, где бы вы ни находились, прямо в приложении
• Расширить сеть профессиональных контактов и оставаться на связи
• Связаться с другими участниками и просмотреть их профессиональные профили
• Делиться статьями с целью упрочить свою репутацию в качестве эксперта
• Отслеживать компании для получения объявлений о вакансиях, деловых обновлений и предложений установить контакт с людьми, которых вы можете знать
• Повысить статус учётной записи LinkedIn до уровня «Премиум» прямо в приложении
ru_RU.changelog: Благодарим за использование LinkedIn! Мы постоянно обновляем наше приложение, чтобы исправить ошибки, повысить производительность и добавить новые функциональные возможности, что помогает вам устанавливать контакт со специалистами в вашей отрасли и развивать свою карьеру.

en_US.title: LinkedIn: Job Search & Network
en_US.description:
Welcome to your professional community. Connect and build your professional network, find jobs, learn from industry experts, and access business news.

Find jobs online in the UK—create a professional profile to showcase your experience and resume, and discover your next career opportunity. Use AI-powered tools to find roles that match your skills and career interests.

Connect with professionals and companies, discover new opportunities, read collaborative articles, stay informed with business news, and build meaningful relationships that support your professional journey.

Build meaningful connections as you expand your professional network. Connect with recruiters, explore job opportunities, develop your skills through expert insights and collaborative articles, improve your visibility, and stay up to date with the latest industry trends and business news.

Why you'll love the LinkedIn app:
• AI-powered job search: Discover opportunities that match your skills, experience, and career goals.
• Business news & learning: Stay informed with business news, read collaborative articles, and learn from industry experts.
• Career tools: Get job alerts about opportunities tailored to you and your desired salary.

Find the work that's right for you through LinkedIn's professional network.

LinkedIn App Features:

FIND THE RIGHT OPPORTUNITIES FOR YOU
• Easy apply: Apply to jobs quickly using your LinkedIn profile and showcase your professional experience.
• Job alerts: Stay informed about new opportunities from companies you follow and roles that match your interests.

BUILD MEANINGFUL CONNECTIONS WITH YOUR PROFESSIONAL NETWORK
• Career advancement: Grow professionally in your community with the right tools.
• Professional network: Network with business contacts, companies, and industry leaders.
• Social networking: Businesses can showcase their services and products to find new career opportunities.
• Make professional community connections: Follow professionals and companies for updates and content on the latest news.

PROFESSIONAL INSIGHTS & CONVERSATIONS
• Stay informed with industry news, expert perspectives, and insights from the professionals and companies you follow.
• Professional insights: Discover expert insights, collaborative articles, and community conversations.

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
• Highlight career experience using your LinkedIn profile as an online resume.
• Share your job experience, accomplishments, and skills on your professional profile.
• Connect with professionals and opportunities by keeping your profile up to date and visible to the right people.

SOCIAL NETWORKING
• Build meaningful connections and join groups that share and support your goals.
• Find your community and join LinkedIn, one of the largest social networking apps for professionals worldwide.

SOLVE PUZZLES WITH YOUR NETWORK
• Keep your mind sharp with our quick daily logic, word, and trivia puzzles: Mini Sudoku, Tango, Zip, Queens, Patches, Wend, Pinpoint, and Crossclimb.
• Re-connect with your connections on the leaderboard and keep your streak going.

Explore opportunities and take the first steps in finding the right job for you on LinkedIn!

Build your professional profile, apply for your next job, and connect with recruiters. Professionals and companies come together in the largest professional networking app to advance your career. Start and finish your job search with LinkedIn.

Want to make the most of LinkedIn? Upgrade to a Premium subscription for exclusive AI tools.

We ask for a few permissions when you use this app. Here’s why:
http://linkd.in/1l0S8YZ

-

LinkedIn members have the option to verify their identity by securely uploading a government ID and/or taking a live selfie using certain trusted partners. For more information about the data collected by our trusted partners through this process and the periods for which it will be retained, see: https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a1359065
en_US.shortDescription: Smarter career moves start here. AI job alerts, insights & the right tools.
en_US.changelog: Thanks for using LinkedIn! We regularly update our app to fix bugs, improve performance and add new features to help you connect with your professional network and advance your career.
